title: Zoning map change for 9305 Fifth Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This resolution approves, with modifications, a zoning map amendment to rezone property at 9305 Fifth Avenue in Bay Ridge, Brooklyn from R6B/C2-3 and R5B to R7D/C2-4. It would facilitate an 11-story, 233,361 square-foot mixed-use building with 292 apartments, about 88 of which would be permanently income-restricted under Mandatory Inclusionary Housing. The Council approved the change on October 8, 2026, after a September 9, 2026 public hearing.
